question: Who was conferred with the National Nritya Shiromani Award 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Aparna Satheesan**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• National Nritya Shiromani Award is an annual award given to exceptional classical dancers and musicians of India for their contribution to art and culture.
 
• **Aparna Satheesan, the international Kuchipudi dancer received the National Nritya Shiromani Award for 2022 at the 13th Cuttak Mahotsav. Hence option 2 is correct.**
 
• She is from Kerala, an expert in Bharatnatyam and a senior disciple of Guru Smt. Vyjayanthi Kashi.
 
• **Kuchipudi **is one of the 8 major Indian classical dances and originated from **Andhra Pradesh while Bharatnatyam originated from Tamil Nadu.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Anindita Neogy Anaam**, from Wisconsin, USA, is an Indian expert and choreographer in **Kathak dance which originated from Uttar Pradesh.** 

 
 
• **​She received Shri Jayadev Rashtriya Yuva Puraskar, Bidagdha Nartaki Samman and National Nritya Shiromani.**
 
• She is currently the Secretary of the Wisconsin Dance Council Board of members and the first Indian to do so.
 
 
 
• **Shantha Dhananjayan**, the wife of V P Dhananjayan is an Indian classical dancer in **Bharatnatyam** and also learnt Kathakali and Carnatic music.
 
 
• Both are known as the dancing couple of India and are the most prominent and accomplished dancers and teachers.
 
 
 
• **Birju Maharaj** is an Indian classical dancer in** Kathak** and a singer who practised Hindustani classical music.
 
 
• **​In 1986, he was honoured with Padma Vibhushan.**
